    Ambient multiplicity data for a primitive deletion #

    The frozen manuscript uses one natural-valued function d_X = [X:E] on all ambient indecomposable modules. Its zero set is the killed subcategory, and the projective cover and injective envelope identify it with both ambient Hom dimensions. This file proves that those ambient identities descend across the literal factor and supply PrimitiveTraceInput automatically.
